q: Which apostle wrote the letter of 1 Peter?
quote: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ

q: In 1 Peter, why should we cast all our anxiety on God?
quote: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.

q: In 1 Peter, the devil prowls around like what?
quote: Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.

q: In 1 Peter, what covers over a multitude of sins?
quote: because love covers over a multitude of sins.

q: In 1 Peter, believers should crave spiritual milk like what?
quote: Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk

q: In 1 Peter, what should you always be ready to explain to anyone who asks?
quote: Always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope that is in you.

q: In 1 Peter, believers are called a chosen people and a royal what?
why: Called out of darkness into light.
quote: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation

q: In 1 Peter, God has given us new birth into a living what?
quote: He has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead

q: In 1 Peter, while grass withers, what stands forever?
quote: but the word of the Lord stands forever.

q: In 1 Peter, where did Christ bear our sins in His body?
why: So we might live to righteousness.
quote: He Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree

q: In 1 Peter, believers have returned to the Shepherd and what of their souls?
why: They had been like straying sheep.
quote: but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

q: In 1 Peter, how many people were saved in Noah's ark?
quote: In the ark a few people, only eight souls, were saved through water.

q: In 1 Peter, through whom did Peter write the letter?
why: Peter called him a faithful brother.
quote: Through Silvanus, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly

q: In 1 Peter, whom does Peter call “my son”?
In 1 Peter, the church in which city sends greetings?
why: It was chosen together with them.
quote: The church in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you greetings

q: In 1 Peter, which of these regions is named among the readers' homes?
why: They were exiles of the Dispersion.
quote: throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia
